baseline.output:
- Orders of 10 items or more now get the 5% bulk discount; the threshold used to be 13.
- Invalid quantities now fail with a stable INVALID_QUANTITY error code instead of a bare message.
- Line prices are rounded once at the end, so totals no longer drift on multi-item orders.
